# From rationale to reproducible result.

SCOP Learn is a bilingual teaching site for the SCOP R package. Each lesson keeps the same rhythm: biological rationale, R code, expected insights, interpretation boundary, and provenance.

<span class="version-chip">Validated locally with SCOP 0.8.9</span>
:::

::: {.grid .gap-4 .mb-5}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}

[Follow the learning path](start-here.qmd) from data and object structure to a complete analysis.
:::
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}

## Understand the pieces

[Read the concepts](concepts.qmd) behind assays, layers, reductions, metadata, and evidence.

## Run two cases

[Single-cell](single-cell-case.qmd) and [spatial](spatial-case.qmd) cases are executed locally and published with provenance.
:::
:::
:::

## How to use this site

1. Read the biological question before copying code.
2. Confirm that your input matches the lesson contract.
3. Run the smallest checkpoint first.
4. Compare your result with the expected insight, not with a decorative screenshot.
5. Record the package, R, data, and environment identities.

::: {.grid .gap-4}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.case-card}
## Complete single-cell case

A synthetic two-state count matrix is carried through QC, normalization, variable-feature selection, PCA, neighbors, clusters, UMAP, and dimension estimation.

[Open the case →](single-cell-case.qmd)
:::
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.case-card}
## Complete spatial case

A synthetic spatial grid is carried through normalization, spatially variable feature scoring, and a KNN spatial network.

[Open the case →](spatial-case.qmd)
:::
:::
:::

::: {.boundary}
SCOP Learn teaches reproducible package use. It does not turn exploratory cell- or spot-level patterns into clinical, patient-level, or causal claims.
:::

## Keep the sources distinct

- [SCOP API Reference](https://mengxu98.github.io/scop/reference/) — the upstream function-level reference.
- [SCOP Studio](https://carl6231.github.io/scop-studio-site/) — the separate product and local workflow site.
- [Reproducibility](reproducibility.qmd) — version, data, environment, and artifact records for this site.
